settings.title: Settings
settings.lang.title: Language
settings.lang.help: Switches the whole app at once: text, dates, numbers, charts, notices and notifications. It is remembered for next time.
settings.theme.title: Theme
settings.notif.title: Notifications
settings.notif.help: Local reminders only: work permit expiry, responses to USCIS and important alerts. Nothing is sent to a server.
settings.notif.dataMonths: Tell me when USCIS publishes new data
settings.notif.denied: The phone did not grant permission for notifications. You can turn it on in the phone settings.
settings.notif.webOnly: Notifications exist only in the phone app. On this page, news appears under Alerts.
settings.discreet.title: Discreet mode
settings.discreet.label: Hide my case details
settings.discreet.help: Hides the nickname, dates and entry channel on "My case" until you tap "show". It is not a security protection.
settings.cases.title: Your cases ({n} of {max})
settings.cases.none: There are no cases saved on this device.
settings.cases.deleteBody: It is deleted from this device only, together with its reminders. This cannot be undone.
settings.data.title: Data source
settings.delete.title: Delete all my data
settings.delete.help: Deletes from this device your cases, the settings, the read alerts, the reminders and the saved copy of the data.
settings.delete.step1.title: Delete all your data?
settings.delete.step1.body: This deletes from this device your cases (up to 3), the settings, the read alerts, the reminders and the saved copy of the data. This cannot be undone.
settings.delete.step2.title: Confirm the deletion
settings.delete.step2.body: Tap "Delete everything" to delete your data now.
settings.delete.done: Your data was deleted from this device.
myths.title: Is it true?
myths.intro: Rumors that circulate among Cubans, checked against sources. When in doubt, consult an attorney or accredited representative.

about.title: About
about.what.title: What CAA Tracker is
about.what.body: An independent, unofficial tool to understand, with public USCIS data, how Cuban Adjustment Act green card applications are moving. It is not affiliated with USCIS, DHS or any government agency, it does not check your case status with USCIS, and it does not give legal advice.
about.disclaimer.title: Notice
about.tags.title: Evidence tags
about.data.title: Where the data comes from
about.data.uscis: USCIS files are U.S. Government works with no copyright; we cite them as "Source: USCIS".
about.data.mirrors: When the USCIS site does not respond, we use community copies of the same files, checked with their sha256 fingerprint, and say so on each source.
about.data.curated: Alerts, court cases and rumors are reviewed by a person before they are published.
about.code.title: Code and data
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.vault.title: Your information stays with you
privacy.vault.native: Nothing personal leaves your phone. The app has no accounts, ads, analytics or third-party crash reporting.
privacy.vault.web: On this page, your data lives only in this browser's storage. It never reaches the publisher of the page, Claude or GitHub. If the browser does not allow saving, everything stays in memory and is lost when you close it.
privacy.stored.title: What is stored on your device
privacy.stored.case: Your case dates and steps, entry channel, state and office (if you enter them).
privacy.stored.nickname: An optional nickname for each case.
privacy.stored.receipt: If you type it, the full receipt number is kept on the device only and shown masked; we recommend typing only the 3 letters.
privacy.stored.settings: Your settings, the alerts you read and the scheduled reminders.
privacy.stored.cache: A copy of the public data to use offline.
privacy.never.title: What we never store or ask for
privacy.never.identity: Your name, A-number, date of birth, address, ZIP code, phone or e-mail.
privacy.never.credentials: Passwords for myUSCIS or any other site.
privacy.network.title: What is downloaded
privacy.network.native: The app only downloads public data files (JSON) from GitHub. As with any download, GitHub sees your connection's IP address.
privacy.network.web: This page only reads the data files published next to it. It sends nothing about your case.
privacy.tips.title: To protect your information even more
privacy.tips.prefix: Type only the 3 letters of your receipt number (for example, IOE).
privacy.tips.month: If you prefer, use only the month for dates.
privacy.tips.discreet: Turn on discreet mode in Settings; remember it is not a security protection.
privacy.delete.title: Delete everything
privacy.delete.body: In Settings you can delete all your data from this device in two taps and cancel the reminders.
